**CS2 highlights now count every kill of a round.**

**Download:** `ClipRing-v0.1.2-win-x64.zip` below, unzip, start `ClipRing.exe`. No installation; .NET and FFmpeg are included. Your settings are kept.

### Fixed
- **Multi-kills in Counter-Strike 2 were often not saved.** Kills only counted together if they were at most a few seconds apart, so a 3K with pauses in between produced no clip. Now all kills of a round end up in one clip (2K, 3K, 4K or Ace), however far apart they are.

### Changed
- A highlight is saved as soon as the round is over for you: when you die, the round ends, the match ends or you get an ace.
- The clip runs from a few seconds before your first kill to a few seconds after your last one, without the time you spend spectating afterwards.

Windows may warn because the program is not signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.
